description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the AWS Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to application components, assessments, import tasks, server details, and configurations. The class extends the AwsClient base class, indicating it leverages the AWS SDK client infrastructure.

classes.name: MigrationHubStrategyRecommendationsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations service, providing methods to perform various actions related to migration strategies.

methods.name: getImportFileTask
methods.description: Retrieves details of an import file task.

methods.name: getLatestAssessmentId
methods.description: Gets the most recent assessment ID.

methods.name: getPortfolioSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summary information of the portfolio.

methods.name: getRecommendationReportDetails
methods.description: Gets details of a recommendation report.

methods.name: listAnalyzableServers
methods.description: Lists servers that can be analyzed.

methods.name: startRecommendationReportGeneration
methods.description: Starts generation of a recommendation report.

methods.name: updateApplicationComponentConfig
methods.description: Updates configuration for an application component.
